floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 14 re-verified; residual mapped as two separable rotations (A: dy v0/v1 6-insn, B: sq/quotient v1<->a1 8-insn) with a $t1-burn asymmetry pointing at dy liveness as the root

Floor 14 -> 6: reusing disc for the sqrt result (disc = func_8007E11C(disc << 10)) closed all 8 Rotation-B insns; residual 6 is Rotation A only (dy/mult-temp $v0<->$v1 swap), with the RA mechanism pin

frontier.hypothesis: Rotation A closes when the two mult temps (arg2^2, arg3*dy2) are allocated before dy, landing $v1/$t1 and evicting dy to $v0
frontier.mechanism: allocno_compare order: 87's priority sits between 107 and 106; a small ref/live-length change on the temps flips the order; $t0 is spill-reserved so $t1 is the natural overflow temp reg
frontier.next_probe: BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG / instrumented allocno_compare on pseudos 87/106/107 to read the exact priority numbers, then derive a C form that shortens/densifies the temps' ranges without adding insns

frontier.hypothesis: A permuter campaign from the score-6 base finds the Rotation-A closing form directly
frontier.mechanism: the search space is now tiny (one statement family, 6-insn residual); s1's plateau evidence was from the 14-floor base and is stale
frontier.next_probe: permuter_campaign.py on func_800200DC with directed PERM_* around the dy/dy2/disc statements, fresh-seed discipline, harvested in-turn

frontier.hypothesis: The dy==0-arm shares no pseudos with the disc chain, so Rotation A may also root in a cross-arm allocation interaction not yet examined (negu/denom pseudos 90/93/94 conflict with 87)
frontier.mechanism: 87 conflicts list includes 74 75 76 77 80 83 (params/dx/dz/dist) but the zero-arm temps share the same hard regs; their local-alloc outcomes constrain global-alloc's view of $v0
frontier.next_probe: read the zero-arm pseudos' dispositions in the existing s2 greg dump and check whether respelling the zero arm (neg/denom naming) shifts dy's conflict set

judge_constraints: Fresh-variable multi-write relay carriers (any spelling: one new local written 2+ times purely as staging relays) are off the table for this function unless the USER sanctions a new family with its own SOTN-master evidence of a twice-written fresh staging intermediate; the grind continues from the floor-5 disc-carrier form via existing-variable carriers (explain neg's $a1 landing with a FINDREG dump before re-proposing), permuter from the score-5 base, or a spelling that prevents disc's call-arg {4} pref from reaching the arm-2 quotient. The y1 form stays preserved in pending-ruling-y1.c and MAY be surfaced to the user as a NEEDS_USER policy question, stating honestly that the SOTN evidence gap is the multi-write property itself.
